name: comp-230
title: Combobox With Action
description: A combobox with search built on Popover and Command, plus an action button at the bottom (e.g., 'New organization').
use_when: Long lists plus the ability to create a new item inline.
avoid_when: Simple selections or modal creation workflows.
a11y: Combobox role; keyboard navigable; action button is a distinct control.
